select: select a.approval_status as approvalStatus, a.remark, a.case_stage as caseStage, date_format(a.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) as createdTime, cs.`name` AS createdStaffName from jml_case_approval_history a left join jml_staff cs on a.created_staff_id = cs.id where case_id = #{caseId} order by a.created_time desc
select count(id) as cnt from jml_case_approval_history where case_id = #{caseId} and case_stage_code = 'NEW'
